def.zh-tw: 形成太陽系的那一團氣體與塵埃。依太陽星雲說，它因重力收縮；大部分物質聚到中心形成太陽，剩下的物質聚集成行星等天體。
def.en: The cloud of gas and dust from which the solar system formed. By the solar nebula hypothesis, it contracted under gravity; most of the matter gathered at the centre to form the Sun, and the rest gathered into the planets and other bodies.

source.locator: 樂詞網 太陽星雲 solar nebula

def.zh-tw: 判斷地層先後的原則：在沒有翻轉的地層中，下面的岩層先沉積，比上面的岩層老。
def.en: A rule for ordering strata: in layers that have not been overturned, a lower layer was deposited first and is older than the layers above it.

source.locator: 樂詞網 疊置定律 law of superposition

def.zh-tw: 利用岩石或化石中放射性同位素以固定規律衰變，由剩下的母元素與產生的子元素的量推算絕對年代的方法。
def.en: A way to find absolute age from the regular decay of radioactive isotopes in a rock or fossil: the amounts of parent left and daughter produced give the time that has passed.

source.locator: 樂詞網 放射性定年 radiometric dating

def.zh-tw: 放射性同位素的原子有一半衰變成其他原子所需的時間。每種同位素的半衰期固定；經過 n 個半衰期，母元素剩下原來的二分之一的 n 次方。
def.en: The time it takes for half of the atoms of a radioactive isotope to decay into other atoms. Each isotope has a fixed half-life; after n half-lives, one half to the power n of the parent is left.

source.locator: 樂詞網 半衰期 half life
